cards.content: **Floor breakers are status only.** They feed the router, Wi-Fi and this server; switching one off from here could take the network down with no remote way back.

cards.content: These change the inverter directly. Open a tile to change it.
Grid fallback closes at **30%** and opens at **40%** (automations). The inverter's own limits below are a safety net under that.
